# Telegram Mini Apps bridge

`telegram-web-app.js` is an unmodified local copy of the official Telegram Mini Apps SDK:

- Source: <https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js>
- Documentation: <https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps>
- Retrieved: 2026-10-18
- SHA-256: `124bdff7ba3fe86c8ba5143467afec21e020405e74abdb92cfdda6c0ee3b5908`

It is served locally so the reader's Content Security Policy can keep `script-src 'self'` and its app shell can be cached offline. Refresh this file deliberately, review API changes and bump the service worker cache version when updating.
